messages:
jia: Quick sync 11: change window tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC. Weve got three moving pieces: api config, router header-split, runtime kernel bump. Keep replies short 6 actions.

deploybot: Confirmed window 2026-03-23 23:00Z-01:00Z. Lock requests: api, router, runtime. Canaries supported. See runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/change-window

samir: Runtime update: v3.2.1 introduces quantized matmul kernels + kernel scheduler tweaks. Canary strategy: 3-step -> 2% for 10m, 10% for 10m, then ramp. If any stage sees p95 +200ms OR error-rate >2.5% OR token throughput -10% -> abort and rollback. Also GC pause pattern changed slightly; watch tail-latency.

alex: Console note: header-split means client routing header toggles. We will not flip UI flags until router stable for 10m after final canary stage. If runtime rollback happens, console stays on safe path.

maria: API plan: we'll prepare api-v2.6.0 but will hold route to it until router pinned. If router not pinned at T0, api remains on api-v2.5.9. Release notes draft here: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-change-draft.md (adding caveat).

jia: Short checklist:
- Pre-T0: clear short TTLs, pin artifacts to deploy candidates
- T0: pin router & runtime, start canary (2% -> 10%)
- T+20m: evaluate metrics, decision owner = @samir
- T+30m: console flip if stable for 10m after final stage
- If abort: immediate rollback to router-v2.5.9 + runtime-v3.2.0

samir: Commands I'll execute after thumbs: 
```
# pin before shift
deployctl pin router=router-v2.6.1 runtime=runtime-v3.2.1
# small-stage canary
deployctl canary --service router --stages "2%:10m,10%:10m" --notify #incidents
```

ops-bot: Alerting update: paging -> #eng-oncall (pager duty), #incidents (ops ops). SLO guards: p95 delta >200ms OR error-rate >2.5% => auto-alert. Auto-failover target set to router-v2.5.9.

maria: Infra reminder: clear cache priming 30m before T0 or enable read-through fallback for 45m. Without that, some requests may hit stale prefixes.

release-bot: Release note: created stub. Please add "kernel bump: quantized kernels; staged router header-split; console toggle gated on runtime/router stability" to the highlights.

alex: Console: will post "console: ready" once I see router stable for 10m after final canary. Ill also monitor client-side error slices.

jia: Decision owner at evaluation = @samir. Samir, if you call abort at any stage, please run the rollback commands and ping #incidents and @oncall.

samir: Acknowledged. Rollback flow:
```
# rollback example
deployctl rollback router --to router-v2.5.9
deployctl rollback runtime --to runtime-v3.2.0
# reopen api pins to api-v2.5.9 until cleared
```

oncall: Watching dashboards from T0 + first 45m. If SLO guard trips, I will escalate and trigger pages.

jia: Ok. Final ask: everyone react with :thumbsup: if ready to proceed. If anyone hits :thumbsdown: post brief reason. We'll reconvene 15m before window to confirm.

(End of thread)
